translations.source_sense_description: reflexiv: ohne Absicht eine falsche Nummer wählen

glosses: To dial or use a keypad incorrectly, especially on a telephone.

examples.text: I misdialled her number and got through to a stranger.
As for Mr. Vashishta, he laughed in embarrassment as he recalled misdialing 911 not once but twice in a weekend.
